approval_mechanism: --approval-token must equal this manifest's content_key; no approval is stored in the manifest itself

cases.rationale: the exact v15 physical case, schedules, variants and seeds; removes the refuted event lookahead and changes only whole-vehicle decimal normalization

claim_scope: proves or refutes cold/warm production-observation equivalence for the frozen cases only; it establishes no product behaviour and no adoption

comparison_policy.compares: the canonical production observation from each arm, excluding execution-only fields
comparison_policy.on_mismatch: record honest fail evidence and publish no cache material
comparison_policy.tolerance: exact equality of the semantic payload

demand_requirement.note: the campaign must bind this exact archive; resolving the key alone is ambiguous across successful archives

execution_history.note: v15 completed three genuine warm executions and a bounded q10 forensic pair localized its full 21.73-second residual to 2173 one-cent rounding ties. v16 remains OFF until a fresh paired campaign passes every exact gate.

hypothesis_under_test.claim: SUMO-compatible half-up normalization of each joined whole-vehicle millisecond value eliminates the exact one-cent-per-tie residual without changing traffic state
hypothesis_under_test.refutation_condition: any semantic mismatch, missing identity, abnormal exit or failed performance gate rejects v16 and publishes no cache
hypothesis_under_test.status: UNPROVEN — v16 is unapproved and unexecuted

inherited_from.reason: v16 preserves the full v15 physical experiment and safety gates while correcting the localized formatter semantic

lifecycle_rules.drift_is_the_retirement_mechanism: a superseded contract's fingerprints drift and its load fails closed; that drift is never repaired or re-synced
lifecycle_rules.immutable_history_pins: a campaign's immutable-history map pins predecessor TOOL and MANIFEST bytes only; predecessor TEST files are never pinned, because a retiring suite must stay free to describe its own supersession
lifecycle_rules.no_currency_assertions_in_versioned_suit: a versioned suite contains no assertion that must be rewritten solely because the harness default advanced; currency-dependent facts are read from production, and which manifest is current is proved in the generic current suite
lifecycle_rules.why: v8 pinned a predecessor test file and asserted its own currency, so a successor could not land without editing frozen evidence. Evidence that must be edited when the future arrives is not frozen

localhost_bind_preflight.execution_requirement: the approved command must run in an environment permitting localhost TCP bind
localhost_bind_preflight.on_failure: fail before keyed-root inspection/creation and before campaign execution

luna_warm_22_localization.finding: the residual is carried entirely by a MINORITY of the vehicles in flight across the warm point
luna_warm_22_localization.most_lose_everything: 1 of 5, 8 of 10 and 10 of 12 restored with EXACTLY 0.0 accumulated time loss
luna_warm_22_localization.partition_was_clean: no missing, extra, overlapping or misplaced vehicles in any identity
luna_warm_22_localization.selection_mechanism: UNKNOWN and not required by this correction

meso_accumulator_reconstruction.active_population_digest_validation: recompute warm_boundary_active_v3 from the exact warm point and sorted entry IDs on every read
meso_accumulator_reconstruction.completed_record_order: persist SUMO prefix XML order separately from the canonical ID map and continue that accumulator across resumed XML order

normalization.evidence: q10 v15 forensics found 2173 timeLoss-only values each exactly 0.01 low; total -21.73 s

meso_accumulator_reconstruction.rule: capture exact active IDs and save at the exact warm point; partition immediate unfinished output by identity; join each active prefix accumulator to its resumed value; normalize every whole vehicle once with SUMO decimal half-up; reject population overlap, omission, duplicate or malformed data

performance_reporting.claim_policy: speedup is REPORTED, never claimed as proven until an approved paired run passes

regression_binding.rule: every source and regression interpreting SUMO decimal normalization, mesoscopic reconstruction or the paired verdict is fingerprinted

resumed_execution_contract.reason: v13 reads no terminal TraCI vehicle value; retaining every arrived vehicle would add memory/runtime without evidence

source_established_defect.state_omission: MSDevice_Tripinfo::saveState/loadState serialize other tripinfo fields but omit myMesoTimeLoss
source_established_defect.traci_mismatch: MEVehicle::getTimeLoss returns getWaitingTime; it is not the mesoscopic tripinfo accumulator

supersedes.outcome: EXECUTED with three exact time-loss mismatches and NO_CACHE_PUBLISHED

traci_resolution.controller_rule: the controller resolves before the launcher and before any port, so an unusable TraCI starts no process
traci_resolution.home_rule: a non-empty SUMO_HOME wins deterministically; a declared-but-unusable home is an error, never a silent fallback to a different installation
traci_resolution.preflight_order: approval token -> TraCI resolve/API check -> artifact-root absence -> campaign; a resolver failure creates no root and runs no campaign
traci_resolution.rule: TraCI is imported from the exact active <sumo_home>/tools and the imported module's origin MUST resolve inside that installation's traci package; a module from anywhere else is refused

v12_review.finding: TraCI save/restore ledgers were equal but final mesoscopic tripinfo differed because they observed waiting time, not the private accumulator SUMO omitted from saved state

v13_review.claim: environmental failure only; the fallback pairs prove neither warm equivalence nor warm performance

v14_review.claim: v14 proved the warm runtime path and all non-time-loss semantics, but refuted exact time-loss equivalence

v15_review.lookahead_result: event-dependent: changed q50 by 1.09 s and changed neither q10 nor q90; refuted

v6_diagnosis.cause: production did a bare `import traci`; the package ships inside the installation at <sumo_home>/tools/traci and is not on sys.path
v6_diagnosis.consequence: warm execution never started once: every warm arm since the controller was introduced was a cold fallback caused by an import error
v6_diagnosis.observed: cache_miss -> bootstrap_started -> snapshot_failed[No module named 'traci', ModuleNotFoundError] -> bootstrap_failed, on all three identities

v7_review.correct_in_v7: the resolver repair, the origin proof, the pre-root preflight ordering and the real-import regression, all carried forward unchanged
v7_review.defect: incomplete regression binding: the fingerprint set omitted tests/test_warm_state_boundary.py and tests/test_monthly_warm_state.py
v7_review.found_by: process-free Sol review, no campaign spent
v7_review.probe: one audit-guarded import-only probe of the installed package passed under v7 and is CONSUMED evidence: the resolved origin lay inside the active <sumo_home>/tools/traci and the required API was complete. It has not been rerun and proves nothing about warm execution, which has still never occurred

v8_review.correct_in_v8: the complete regression binding and its freeze-time enforcement, carried into v9 unchanged
v8_review.defect: lifecycle coupling, not a runtime fault: v8's suite pinned a predecessor TEST file as immutable evidence and asserted its own currency directly, so a successor landing forced edits to artifacts that are supposed to be frozen
v8_review.found_by: process-free Sol review, no campaign spent
v8_review.remedy: immutable-history maps pin predecessor TOOL and MANIFEST bytes only; currency-dependent facts are read from production and proved in the generic current suite, so a versioned suite never needs rewriting merely because the default advanced

v9_result.executed: once, under LUNA-WARM-16, with exact user approval
v9_result.outcome: warm execution SUCCEEDED for the first time in this family — all three identities reached warm_completed — and the paired comparison FAILED: 3 comparisons, 3 mismatches, no cache published
v9_result.performance: cold 91.38 s vs warm 103.15 s for the same schedule; warm was slower, as expected while every identity is a cache miss paying for its own prefix
v9_result.refuted: the state-serialization hypothesis. v9 applied --save-state.rng true and --save-state.precision 16 and the residual was bit-identical to v2's, which predates those settings entirely

warm_attempt_contract.coverage_rule: exactly one FINALIZED attempt per requested warm identity; coverage counts identity attempts, never events
warm_attempt_contract.on_gap: a missing, duplicated, unexpected, malformed or self-contradictory attempt fails the record and forbids cache publication

warming_default: OFF — v16 is unapproved/unexecuted; a fresh paired campaign must pass exact equivalence before cache publication or product activation
